Broadcom Inc. is a public company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, traded under the ticker AVGO. On its own site the company describes itself as delivering semiconductors and infrastructure software for global enterprises' most complex, mission-critical needs, and it uses the tagline "Connecting Everything." Its SEC filing identifier is 0001730168.

The site text does not name specific products or AI offerings, so there is no product-level detail to report here. The company's recorded litigation exposure is in California, with 281 matters. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or tracked products appear in the material available.
